overview_description.description: EButler is a premium managed service marketplace, a one stop shop for any kind of service you need, booked in less than 60 seconds. A marketplace with only vetted & reliable service providers in your city for 300+ services, covering every aspect of your life including your home, car, lifestyle, beauty, children, pets, health, and much more. You name it, we've got it. We handle the mess of life so you can focus on being great. EButler exists to make your life simple and hassle free. No extra fees or markup, amazing customer service and a satisfaction guarantee on any service booked through us.
